full_judgment: 12. Notwithstanding the fact that the principles of State policy are not judicially enforceable like the fundamental rights, Article 22 is very much a part of the Constitution which is nothing but the solemn expression of the will of the people. Had it been enforceable like fundamental rights by the Court, we would not hesitate to pass a decree or make a declaration or direction for its implementation and fulfilment, as a long period of 25 years has already passed from the date of independence of Bangladesh. This Article No. 22 was not meant for beautifying the Constitution as an ornament, but the will of the people was intended to be implemented within a reasonable time and this period of 25 years from independence is definitely a reasonable period to implement the cherished will and desire of the people. Absolute trust and faith in Almighty Allah shall be the basis of all actions which is one of the Fundamental Principles of State policy as per Article 8 of the Constitution. This faith demands that we all should be true to our promise and Article 22 of the Constitution should be implemented in latter and spirit in no time.
